tagline: Your people. One movie. Every week.
aboutIntro: Turn choosing a film into a shared movie night. Mainflix brings your group’s picks, a fair draw and everyone’s reviews together.
aboutGroups: Create a named group for friends or family, or join one through a private invitation. Each group has its own movies, nominations, draws and reviews.
aboutNominate: Each eligible member nominates one movie or skips the week. Search the catalogue, add a missing film or try a random suggestion. You can change your choice until everyone has responded. Other members cannot see which movie you picked.
aboutDraw: Once everyone has nominated or skipped, any member can draw the weekly movie. Each nomination gets one entry: repeated nominations give a movie more chances. Everyone shares the same saved winner. If everyone skips, there is no draw. Selected movies leave future draws unless the group owner restores them.
aboutSurvey: After the draw, guess who nominated each movie. You can select multiple names. Click Send to see the percentages, then Next for the next question. You can skip questions or the whole survey. Once all eligible members finish or skip, everyone sees who nominated what.
aboutReview: Mark the movie watched, then submit your own rating to unlock your friends’ ratings and reviews for that weekly selection. Ratings use 0.5–5 diamonds; written reviews are optional and you can edit your review. Past weekly movies stay in To be reviewed until every eligible member has rated them.
aboutMore: Save private favorites, find your own reviews in My profile, browse previous draws in History and return to unfinished guessing surveys there. Group owners manage invitations and movie eligibility.
